# proxmox_node_ceph_osd_tree (Data Source)

Reads the raw Ceph OSD tree JSON from `/nodes/{node}/ceph/osd`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_node_ceph_osd_tree" "t" {
  node = "pve-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) Cluster node.

### Read-Only

- `tree` (String) JSON object with the CRUSH tree.
